title: Waveshare ESP32-S3-LCD-1.47
summary: 原始1.47非触172×320 ST7789板，16MiB Flash/8MiB PSRAM、USB-A、GPIO38单RGB LED和真实四线TF；与1.47B/Touch1.47的引脚/主控外围分别维护。

facts.label: 主控存储容量
facts.notes: 容量属于此SKU/已注明硬件版本；不从通用ESP32名称推断。

facts.label: 本次实现的源代码接线

value.referenceConflict: Current published ST7789.c mirror(true,false) reference40; original Test BIN observedC0. Frame orientation is recorded, not corrected by a guessed rotation.

facts.label: 官方原版镜像调查
facts.notes: 官方62809763B DemoZIP内精确Firmware/ESP32-S3-LCD-1.47-Test.bin为完整S3镜像，结构/checksum与双SHA通过；页面仅确认Test例程，登记official-demo而非猜测factory。原图5guest秒172×320、11帧46色，实际MADCTL C0与公开BSP参考40不同、画面纵向镜像；保留原帧。期间非565写入1720次拒绝、最终COLMOD55；原图这一阶段没有发起SD命令。

facts.label: 已抓取UIFlow与小智发布目录
facts.notes: 小智列表由100+100+0分页与latest资产ID交叉核对为完整200项。精确名称仅建立候选分发身份，未下载/审计的资产不冒运行兼容。UIFlow当前58项与较旧landing选择器的范围化无Waveshare结果，不证明不存在第三方移植。

模型逐项边界：Native manufacturer source shapes are preserved at unit scale, including original mechanical standoffs and headers; simplified colors do not identify IC packages or establish measured optical appearance.；Mechanical source revision, fitted connector mating, touch accuracy and physical display coordinate calibration remain unvalidated.；The real LED1 emitter is under the acrylic/optical assembly, visible in the inspection view. Emissive material changes followGPIO38, but acrylic light guiding and assembled apparent glow are not fabricated. An initial source56/rear-photoitem4 inference was rejected; originalWiki item4 is an LDO.；Original CAD carries two populated9-pin header assemblies although the retail photo shows bare holes; this is explicitly the manufacturer assembly reference. Actual included/fitted header population forSKU28317 is not established by a separately selectable listing.；The source optical0 includes37.00mm envelope/FPC whereas drawing LCM is36.28mm. Native shapes are not rescaled; independent drawing AA is preserved.2mm apparent screen-corner radius is photo-derived, not a claimed exact manufacturer AA radius.
